title.narrative: Confederation of Autonomous Trade Unions of Vojvodina

description.narrative: The project is implemented in Serbia. The main outcome area it contributes to is equality and workers' rights. The main rights holders are workers. Through trainings, mobilising and advocacy the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsConfederation of Autonomous Trade Unions of Vojvodina (SSSV) and Swedish Trade Union Confederation (LO-distriktet i Vstsverige). Both organisations are regional branches of large trade union confederations in their respective countries.Project ObjectiveThe general project objective is that the trade union movement has a stronger influence on social dialogue in Vojvodina, contributes to the harmonization of Serbias labor law with EU policies, all with involvement of an educated and gender-equal membership base.Actor groupsDecision makers: Government Socioeconomic councils Gender Centers Actors working in cooperation International Trade union associations Employers Union Media Right holders Workers
